caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with an elaborately curved spout on the left and a matching curved handle on the right. The main body of the teapot is bulbous with a wide, rounded base that tapers inward and then flares out again near the middle before narrowing at the top. The teapot features a lid with a finial. The illustration is done in shades of black and gray pencil on a cream-colored background, providing a sense of depth and texture. In the upper right corner, the name “Janet Rigg” is handwritten. The upper left contains a boxed inscription marked “SAVAGE MID. QT 25.” In the lower left corner, there is a smaller schematic drawing of the teapot with measurements: the height from the bottom to the top finial is 7 3/8 inches, the width from the end of the spout to the far edge of the handle is 9 3/8 inches, and the width of the base is 4 7/8 inches. In the lower right corner, there is an additional close-up drawing of the handle with its own measurements: a height of 4 3/4 inches and a width of 3 1/8 inches. The overall composition is precise and technical, focusing on the accurate representation of the teapot and its dimensions.
title: Pewter Teapot
